Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''skirmish''' took place on the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]] at the remains of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which had been [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destroyed]] earlier in the war.
